question: Should Discord subagent progress reactions integrate with the existing acknowledgement/status-reaction lifecycle, or remain an independent owner with explicit collision and cleanup rules?
rationale: Both systems mutate configurable reactions on the same source message, so tests cannot choose the permanent ownership, restoration, and cleanup contract.

options.title: Integrate Reaction Ownership
options.body: Represent subagent progress within the existing Discord reaction lifecycle so additions, transitions, restoration, and cleanup have one owner.

options.title: Keep Independent Owners
options.body: Allow separate owners only with exact reaction ownership tracking and documented collision semantics.

options.title: Narrow To Typing
options.body: Ship typing keepalive without progress reactions to avoid defining the shared-reaction contract in this PR.

recommendation.title: Integrate Reaction Ownership
recommendation.body: Represent subagent progress within the existing Discord reaction lifecycle so additions, transitions, restoration, and cleanup have one owner.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to both the existing Discord reaction lifecycle and the core subagent registry design involved in the choice.
